messages: anya: Short design huddle: playground streaming UX + prompt pallet. New ideas: (1) token odometer inside composer (reads like an odometer that ticks), (2) distinguish Resume vs Stop (Resume replays remainder of stream if paused; Stop saves partial), (3) preserved partials land in a small "draft card" attached to composer, not auto-inserted, (4) Prompt Pallet shortcut Alt+/ to open quick-insert with fuzzy search. Figma: https://figma.com/redwood/playground-odometer ben: Odometer is nice visually. Microcopy: use "Resume" (▶︎) / "Stop" (■ save) / "Retry" (⟳). Keep mobile labels minimal. For odometer: show live ticks and a brief +N overlay on completion. maria: Product rules: Stop -> client-only draft card flagged "stopped_partial=true"; Retry runs against visible composer text (if user edits draft and applies it). Draft card actions: Apply / Discard / Revert to original partial. Do NOT auto-send. sam: Backend: Pause/Resume handled client-side where possible; Stop must emit final tokens_consumed with tag outcome=stopped. Add span attribute `user_action=stop|resume|retry` to traces. Odometer delta requires final event. Pause-resume edge: if server timed out, resume should fall back to regenerate. linda: A11y: odometer should be role=status + aria-live=polite, announce deltas like "+23 tokens used". Draft card must trap focus and announce: "Partial response saved as draft. Press Apply to edit." Example snippet: ``` Tokens: 56 ``` joel: QA: test odometer animations on 3G and low CPU devices; ensure Alt+/ doesn't conflict with browser shortcuts. Also test Apply flow where user edits then Retry. anya: Action items: ben update Figma with odometer + draft card states (ETA EOD), sam add `user_action` trace tag + final token event spike (2d), maria write flow doc and draft card copy (1d), linda assemble a11y snippets & keyboard mapping (2d), joel add QA cases for low perf & shortcut collisions (3d). I'll set a 20m follow-up Tues 9:30am PT. deploy-bot: Reminder: "Playground streaming: odometer + draft card" Tues 09:30 PT. Reply :+1: to RSVP. anya: thanks all leaving thread open for quick comments.
